prompts:
Use case: style-transfer / ui-mockup. Create ONE large high resolution widescreen in-game CONTINENT MAP of "이그니스 타이가", ideally 3840x2160, in the exact sober photorealistic orthographic mapping and minimal UI style of reference image 3. This is an EDIT/RECONSTRUCTION of existing geography, not a newly invented continent.

REFERENCE ROLES AND PRIORITY:
Image 1 (technical world registration map) is the AUTHORITY for the coastline shape, orientation, city point locations, river connectivity and ridge axes. Use its blue rectangular map panel ONLY; discard the surrounding report margins, prose, grid, colored debug IDs and wide schematic ridge lines. Transform that rectangular map panel uniformly to fit most of the new widescreen map area, preserving proportions and all land/ocean relationships. Keep north up. The big south-central bay remains open ocean; preserve both long southern peninsulas, northern jagged shoreline, northeast headlands and east/west coasts. No invented islands.
Image 2 (old terrain painting) is ONLY a reference for the general established terrain hierarchy and natural landcover placement: northern transverse mountain belt, broad western plateaus, central basin and lakes, eastern secondary mountains, southern low plains. Absolutely reject its exaggerated oblique mountain peaks and miniature scenic appearance. Where exact shoreline, river or settlement placements conflict, image 1 takes precedence.
Image 3 (Veles map) is ONLY the accepted UI and realistic ground-treatment STYLE reference. Do not transplant its river shape, village, labels or layout to this continent.

LOOK: credible cloud-free satellite orthomosaic seen from EXACTLY STRAIGHT ABOVE, orthorectified planimetric view, NOT a globe, not an angled drone camera, no horizon, no perspective distortion, NO elevated mountain side silhouettes. Major ridges read as fine branching high-altitude erosion and snow patterns with shallow physically plausible relief shading. Land must feel thousands of kilometers across, NOT a small forest island or tabletop model. Forests are broad naturally irregular dark green landcover masses and fine photographic surface textures; absolutely NO individually identifiable trees, tree cones, trunks, giant bushes or rendered forest props. Settlement buildings are far too small to distinguish at this scale: no tiny castle models or visible houses. Terrain is fine-grained and natural, with real-world varied drainage, barren rock, snow on northern high elevations, muted cold northern tundra, western dry stone plateaus, central boreal woodland and lake basin, eastern dissected uplands, gentler southern agricultural lowlands. Preserve these established zones and ridge alignments rather than inventing another mountain layout. Restrained natural dark greens, gray-brown rock, small pale snow areas, dark desaturated blue ocean with a subtle narrow shallow-water fringe. No turquoise cartoon ocean, golden fantasy forest, parchment, painted outline, contour lines, exaggerated heights, dramatic lighting, haze, cloud, tilt-shift blur, 3D props or decorative strokes.
WORLD TREE: existing position just WEST of the main river in central basin, south of central lake chain. At this continental scale show ONLY a tiny muted pale-olive canopy footprint/point and small label "세계수"; no trunk, no enormous gold tree icon, no luminous orb, no relocated center landmark.

LOCATIONS: use reference 1 city anchors, not the earlier painting. Main cities have small 4-6px neutral offwhite dots at 1672px equivalent width, never ornamental double rings. Labels in regular clean Korean sans serif, modest size, thin contrast halo only.
MUST keep these eight major cities at their reference 1 positions:
"서안항": west coast, about 2.1% width /50.0% height within reference map rectangle.
"하르덴": inland just EAST of western mountain divide, about 24.8% /48.0%.
"북부 관문도시": about 44.2% /32.2%, south of northern mountain belt, NOT on north coast.
"세계수 관리도시": central basin about 49.7% /52.7%, very close southeast of worldtree.
"로덴": about 50.7% /50.3%, just northeast of management city along Tern river. These central cities are CLOSE, do not spread their actual dots to create label space; use short quiet leaders to offset labels if needed.
"세르나": main river mouth at head of southern bay, about 54.4% /72.5%. It is a coastal city, not inland.
"동안항": east coast about 95.8% /49.6%.
"남동 평야도시": southeastern INLAND plain about 75.3% /73.8%, west of eastern ridge and away from coastline.
Small neutral dots also preserve existing secondary town positions visible on reference 1. Secondary names can be suppressed at this zoom to prevent clutter, but do not relocate or invent settlements. The central "벨레스" player point is about 51.4% /49.3%, just northeast of 로덴. Small pale-cyan dot with a tiny heading tick and a clean small "벨레스" label offset northeast; do not depict the Veles village as huge terrain. Do not put Veles elsewhere.
Show only these 8 major city labels, 벨레스 and 세계수 so typography remains readable; avoid invented place names or additional biome text. River courses reference 1: main river runs northeast woodland through central locations south to Serna, western and eastern coast drainage remain separate, northern drainage does not cross the major ridge. Tiny dark natural river lines, not enormous bright blue canals. Main travel corridors may be thin subdued traces, no thick glowing quest paths.

UI COPY AND STYLE must match image 3 exactly: slim flat charcoal top and bottom bars, straight clean minimal layout, normal weight Korean sans-serif like Pretendard/Noto Sans KR, NO calligraphy, serifs, italic labels, ornate compass, gold decoration, gems, embossed icons, illustrated mouse or button frames. Top-left breadcrumb "에테르" then modest title "이그니스 타이가". Top-right small "N" thin arrow and thin close X. Bottom-left same tiny symbol legend "현재 위치" with cyan dot, "도시" with neutral dot, "주요 장소" with muted amber simple square. Bottom-right plain "휠 확대·축소" "Esc 닫기". No report panels, inset maps, coordinate grid, debug IDs, numerical distance statistics, inventory panels or cartographic legend boxes.
Composition: full continent west-to-east and north-to-south visible, generous enough ocean margin to avoid cropping. Main map ~90% screen between UI bars. Deliver a cohesive realistic gameplay map screen, fully nadir and non-cute.

Edit image 1, the new Ignis continent UI map, to fix TWO failures: oblique miniature terrain and displaced city anchors. Image 2 is the authoritative geometric reference; image 3 shows the accepted strict nadir photographic style and austere UI. Preserve the UI design, continent scale, broad coast/bay/peninsula shape, large terrain zones, city names and restrained color. Output one widescreen high resolution map.

PRIMARY ESSENTIAL CHANGE: REPROJECT ALL TERRAIN TO PURE ORTHORECTIFIED SATELLITE NADIR. The current image shows mountain peaks rising vertically UP THE PAGE, huge visible SOUTH-FACING mountain walls, front faces of mesas, and tiny forests as miniature props. THIS IS WRONG. Remove those entirely. Do not just darken or sharpen existing mountains. Rebuild mountains as overhead dendritic RIDGE CRESTS and branching drainage texture: the summit is a point at the center of slope patterns radiating around it, not the TOP OF A TRIANGLE with a tall cliff below. No mountain silhouette overlaps terrain behind it. No displaced summit relative to footprint. No visible vertical side walls of plateaus. Rocks show only upward-facing surface. This must look like a real NASA-style land surface orthomosaic of a continent viewed straight downward, NOT a relief sculpture, miniature island, flight simulator at oblique angle or fantasy painting. Reduce apparent relief amplitude substantially. Flat photographic satellite topography with fine snow tracing branching ridge networks across northern third, northern coast tundra behind them, subdued western eroded plateaus, central low basin and lake chain, east upland drainage, south plains. Forests become broad landcover patches only, not individually rendered trees. Country-scale satellite pixels rather than garden diorama. No cast shadows that make raised peaks, no fake lens blur, no clouds. Keep fine natural ground detail, realistic muted colors, thin natural rivers.

COAST AND SETTLEMENTS: Image 2 blue rectangular map panel is the exact placement reference, ignoring its report framing. Preserve that map panel's ratios. Coastline corners, northeast headlands, northern indentations, southwest peninsula and deep southern bay follow it. In particular don't shrink the southern bay or move shoreline cities inland. The current image1 wrongly spreads Veles and Roden away from central management city, and moves Harden west toward the divide. Correct dots using image 2; labels may move with short thin leaders but actual location dots MUST remain packed.
Based on the full output 1672x941 framing, use these target positions as a close guide, then visually reconcile with coastline/rivers from reference 2:
서안항 near west coastline x82 y480.
하르덴 x430 y475, on EAST side of western mountain divide, not x373.
북부 관문도시 x746 y328, south of northern mountain divide.
세계수 location tiny muted amber square around x824 y488.
세계수 관리도시 point x834 y494.
로덴 point x853 y476.
벨레스 player point x864 y468, NOT the previous x915 y434.
These last four are a tight local cluster. Label "세계수" offset west around x730 y485; label "세계수 관리도시" below around x760 y540; label "로덴" offset east around x895 y505; label "벨레스" offset northeast around x900 y435. Use THIN QUIET NON-CROSSING LEADERS where needed. Never spread actual dots for typography convenience. Local river must pass these city anchors like image 2 then continue to Serna, not bypass them far to the east.
세르나 x900 y646 at existing head of bay shoreline river mouth.
동안항 x1602 y484 on east coast.
남동 평야도시 x1243 y665 inland, NOT at coast.
No extra city models. Existing minor settlements only small quiet dots; no new named settlements, no magnified inset.

PRESERVE THE EXISTING MINIMAL UI: charcoal thin top/bottom bars, small regular straight Korean sans serif, top "에테르 > 이그니스 타이가", small N arrow and X, bottom "현재 위치" "도시" "주요 장소", plain "휠 확대·축소" "Esc 닫기". All map labels sans serif, no pictorial tree, no ornament. Keep current 8 main city names plus 세계수 and 벨레스. Worldtree only tiny flat square at continental scale.
The intended visual change is DRAMATICALLY FLATTER, STRICTLY VERTICAL SATELLITE terrain with corrected tight central positions. Do not return the same mountain-side diorama.

Make ONLY TWO small UI anchor corrections to this image. Preserve ALL terrain, coastline, mountains, rivers, interface bars, typography, other city markers and labels exactly. Do not restyle or regenerate the map.
Image size is 1671x941, coordinates below measured from top-left.
1. HAR_DEN: remove the current pale city dot at (373,484) and its Korean text "하르덴" at approximately (388,487), restoring unobscured terrain beneath. Put the same small city dot at (430,475) and the text "하르덴" just to its right around (444,475). This is a modest EASTWARD move of 57 pixels, not a new city. Leave the nearby unrelated tiny secondary dots alone.
2. VELES: remove the cyan player dot at (907,434), its small directional tick, and its label "벨레스" around (918,421), restoring terrain. Put the cyan player dot at (864,468), immediately NORTHEAST of the existing "로덴" city dot at (851,483). The two actual dot centers must be ONLY about 20 pixels apart. Retain a tiny cyan heading tick. Put label "벨레스" at (908,440) and a fine subdued short leader from the dot (864,468) to the label. Text can be offset, but the cyan dot MUST be in the tight central group at (864,468), not at its old northern position.
No other changes. There must be exactly ONE 하르덴 label/dot and ONE 벨레스 player dot/label in the finished image. Keep the realistic flat satellite terrain and all other city positions unchanged.

validation.visual: Eight major city labels, Veles and worldtree shown; minimal sans-serif UI; reduced oblique mountain silhouettes; central cluster and Harden corrected in final edit.
validation.limits: Generated style mockup, not georeferenced output. Exact coast, river paths, all 36 settlement coordinates and pixel preservation not validated. Minor settlement labels suppressed at continent zoom; no game implementation.
